A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before you
settle in.

Have something else in mind?
We’re a message away.

Ask our host
Where are the homes located?+

Sheloh Homes is in Kyanja, Kampala, Uganda. Message our host for the exact location and directions to the home available for your dates.

How much does a stay cost?+

Send your preferred dates and guest count to receive a quote. The host will confirm the available home, total price, any deposit and booking terms before you commit.

Can I book a longer stay?+

Yes, you can enquire about a longer stay. Choose your dates and select “Longer stay” in the enquiry. We’ll discuss availability and pricing directly with you.

Can you help with a special occasion?+

Let us know what you’re celebrating in your booking enquiry. Styling, arrangements and any extra charges must be agreed with the host in advance.

What about check-in and cancellation?+

Check-in and check-out times, guest policies, payment requirements and cancellation terms are confirmed by the host for your booking. Please ask for these details before making payment.

What happens when I send an enquiry?+

Your stay details become a neatly formatted WhatsApp message. You review it here, then press send in WhatsApp. Your reservation is only confirmed once the host agrees the details with you.

A CLOSER LOOK

YOUR DETAILS
A little privacy.
Your enquiry is prepared in your browser. This website does not store booking information in a database or take payments. Your details are passed to WhatsApp when you choose to continue and are sent to the host only when you send the message there.
WhatsApp and linked social services have their own privacy policies. The host uses the information you share to discuss your stay. For questions about your information, email shelohhomes@gmail.com.
